region.label: Southern Indiana, western Kentucky and southeastern Illinois
region.note: Location exploration is available only in this researched region. Milky Way calculations continue worldwide for the location you choose.

publication.rule: Only areas whose after-dark access is documented by the managing agency, with a legal place to park or a documented standing permission, are published. Ownership alone is not permission.

terrain.note: A parcel has no single horizon, and the centre of a parcel has no verified observation point. These are the steepest modelled direction at each of the pilot's sampled points, offered as regional context only; a clearance angle needs a specific observation point, which this release does not have.
terrain.bareEarth: Bare earth only: trees, crops, buildings, levees and vehicles are not in the model.

sky.message: Local artificial sky brightness has not yet been assessed for these locations.

limitations: These are areas, not observation points: no parking place, trailhead, gate or tripod position is verified.
An area has no single horizon; a clearance angle needs a specific observation point.
Bare-earth terrain only: trees, crops, buildings and levees are not modelled.
No artificial sky brightness is assessed, so no area is described as dark.
Distances are straight-line to the nearest mapped boundary: not a drive, and no travel time is implied.
Check the agency source and current conditions before travelling; seasonal closures and hunting seasons apply.
